predecessors.name: Federated Malay States
predecessors.text: the four Federated Malay States: Selangor, Perak, Negeri Sembilan and Pahang, with Kuala Lumpur

predecessors.name: Straits Settlements
predecessors.text: the Straits Settlements of Penang and Malacca, 'excluding Singapore'

predecessors.name: Unfederated Malay States
predecessors.text: the five Unfederated Malay States: Johor, Kedah, Kelantan, Perlis and Terengganu

predecessors.name: British Military Administration Malaya
predecessors.text: the Malayan Union: the Federated and Unfederated Malay States with Penang and Malacca; Singapore 'administered as a separate crown colony'

successors.name: Federation of Malaya
successors.text: the Malayan Union: the Federated and Unfederated Malay States with Penang and Malacca; Singapore 'administered as a separate crown colony'

ledger.x: 1 April 1946: the Malayan Union is established at Kuala Lumpur.
1 April 1946: the Federated Malay States join the Union.
1 April 1946: Penang and Malacca join the Union.
1 April 1946: the five Unfederated Malay States join the Union.
31 January 1948: the Malayan Union is dissolved and replaced by the Federation of Malaya.

certainty.note: The Union kept the boundaries of its component states and settlements, fixed by treaty and survey (the Thai frontier by the 1909 Anglo-Siamese treaty); the offshore limits are approximate.
